**I’d block the merge on one permission bug.**

**[P1] View-only shares can edit unlocked documents — `src/guard.js:12`**
`===` binds more tightly than `&`, so:
```js
share.mask & WRITE === WRITE
```
is evaluated as `share.mask & (WRITE === WRITE)`—effectively checking bit `1` (`READ`), not `WRITE`.

Confirmed:
- A viewer (`READ`) **can edit**.
- A commenter (`READ | COMMENT`) **can edit**.
- A share with `WRITE` but no `READ` **cannot edit**.

Use `hasRight(share.mask, WRITE) && !share.locked`, consistent with `canComment`, or parenthesize the bitwise operation.

All six existing tests pass; the editor test masks the bug because an editor has both READ and WRITE. Add negative coverage for viewers/commenters and a WRITE-only case.

Reviewed `share-editing` against `main` at `1dc003f`. No files changed.
